$comment: storefront-mcp tool catalog (proposal). Offer-spec sub-schemas are a hand-written representative subset here; the implementation derives them mechanically from the ServiceOffer CRD structural schema (internal/embed/infrastructure/base/templates/serviceoffer-crd.yaml, generated from internal/monetizeapi types by `just generate`). Shared shapes are under $defs. Validity is ultimately enforced by the ValidatingWebhookConfiguration (see the proposal doc §1-§2); plan_offer surfaces the webhook's findings via kubectl apply --dry-run=server, so a tool call and a raw apply hit the same gate.

server.name: storefront
server.auth: bearer (per-agent token minted from StorefrontGrant; go-sdk auth.RequireBearerToken; verifier watches the token Secret via informer for bounded revocation)

code.description: stable machine code, e.g. price-required, path-conflict, path-reserved, hostname-not-granted, logo-cors, logo-unreachable, design-copy-invalid, design-not-yet-rendered, quota-exceeded, price-out-of-bounds, ledger-provenance

field.description: JSON pointer into the offer spec, e.g. /payment/price

priceTable.description: USDC human-decimal strings; at least one field REQUIRED by the webhook (the CRD alone admits price:{} which gates at $0, payment.go:141). perEpoch is fine-tuning-only.

design.description: Structured visual identity. Tokens only — no raw HTML/CSS. Rendered server-side (Phase 2) into the per-offer landing (P1), the 402 paywall, and storefront cards. On a pre-Phase-2 cluster a non-empty design block yields a design-not-yet-rendered warning finding (syntactically valid, no-op).

heroTitle.description: free text; HTML-escaped on render, reject-not-mangle validation (control chars and raw <>& forbidden in source → design-copy-invalid). NOT sanitizeDisplayToken, whose identifier allowlist would strip spaces.

heroTagline.description: free text; same validation as heroTitle

icon.description: https URL, /-relative, or data:image/*;base64 (decoded max 256 KiB — ConfigMap budget)

namespace.description: must be within grant.offerNamespaces; defaults to the grant's first namespace

path.description: default /services/<name>; checked against reserved-path denylist and cross-offer first-claimant conflict

hostname.description: P1 per-offer origin; must match a grant.hostnamePatterns entry

registration.description: ERC-8004 metadata; on-chain publication gated by grant.registration (may require operator approval)

drainGracePeriod.description: Go duration, default 1h; used by retire mode=drain

tools.name: storefront_whoami
tools.description: Return the caller's StorefrontGrant: allowed offer namespaces, remaining quota, allowed types, price bounds, hostname patterns, profile/registration permissions. Call first; plan within the charter.

tools.name: storefront_list_offers
tools.description: List offers visible under the grant with name, namespace, type, path/hostname, price, condition summary, resumeCovered.

namespace.description: optional filter; must be within grant

tools.name: storefront_get_offer
tools.description: Full offer view: normalized spec, conditions, public URLs (paid surface, openapi, landing), provenance labels, resumeCovered flag.

tools.name: storefront_plan_offer
tools.description: Submit the draft spec to the apiserver via kubectl apply --dry-run=server so the ValidatingWebhookConfiguration returns AUTHORITATIVE findings (price-required, grant bounds, quota, path first-claimant conflict, reserved paths, hostname grant, logo/contact, design). Then normalize + diff live state. Returns {planId, action, diff, findings, approvalRequired}. dryRun:true returns findings only (no planId/diff) — this subsumes a separate validate tool. NO mutation.

dryRun.description: true = validity check only, skip diff/planId

expiresAt.description: 30-min TTL; plans with approvalRequired or a recorded preview never hard-expire (apply re-validates in place)

tools.name: storefront_apply_plan
tools.description: Apply a plan by id. Uses resourceVersion optimistic concurrency — a 409 (object changed) forces a re-plan; the WEBHOOK re-runs path-conflict against live state at admission, so a sibling offer claiming the path between plan and apply is rejected there (not missed). Server-side apply, field-manager storefront-mcp (no Force); labels obol.org/created-by; emits an audit Event. The controller records the offer in-cluster so it survives stack down/up. Returns initial conditions; poll storefront_offer_status for convergence.

resumeCovered.description: true once the controller has written the in-cluster offer record (Phase 0); the offer survives stack down/up

tools.name: storefront_offer_status
tools.description: Conditions plus convergence probes: (a) catalog publish — the offer's entry visible in the rendered services.json; (b) live probe of the public URL (expect 402 with accepts[] on the paid surface, 200 on free discovery docs). Distinguishes applied from serving.

ok.description: status matches expectation for the surface (402 paid / 200 free)

tools.name: storefront_preview_landing
tools.description: Render the buyer-visible artifacts for a plan or live offer WITHOUT applying: landing HTML (from design tokens + fixed template), offer-scoped openapi.json, /.well-known/x402. Pure function of the input.

tools.name: storefront_set_profile
tools.description: Plan/apply a patch to the store-wide StorefrontProfile (displayName, tagline, logoUrl, contactEmail). Requires grant.allowProfile. Non-empty fields overlay (MergeProfile semantics); logo and email validated. Two-phase like offers: omit planId to plan, pass it to apply.

tools.name: storefront_retire_offer
tools.description: Safe retire. mode=drain: patch spec.drainAt (+grace) — route and payment gate stay up for in-flight buyers, discovery flips available=false, controller tears down routes at drain expiry. mode=delete: requires Drained conditions (finalizer then serializes route teardown and ERC-8004 handoff/cleanup). confirm must echo the offer name exactly.
